construct: .cf-root { --cf-scoped-pad: 15px } .cf-root .cf-a { padding-inline: var(--cf-scoped-pad) } — a token DECLARED ON THE COMPONENT ROOT (not :root) and consumed by a descendant (antd cssVar component tokens on `.antd.ant-btn`)
why: antd declares its 152 component tokens on the cssVar key class of each component root, never on :root. The reader binds by matching rules to elements and resolving one hop — the name must bind on the descendant exactly as a :root declaration would, and the regate page (which renders against the :root-scoped antd.vars.css) must print a contradiction-count drift rather than swallow one (P2 exam S4).

canvas.note: paddingLeft/Right bound to the scoped-pad variable
